canonical_name: Kuratowski forbidden-subdivision characterization of planar graphs (exact encoding open)
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib under machine-theorem-assurance/1.0; canonical target not yet encoded
literal_source_claim_zh: 平面图的禁用子图刻画
literal_source_claim_en: A characterization of planar graphs by forbidden subgraphs.
canonical_statement: Provisional theorem-family scope: a graph is planar if and only if it contains neither K5 nor K3,3 as a topological minor, equivalently no subgraph isomorphic to a subdivision of either obstruction. Exact graph, planarity, subdivision, containment, and boundary conventions remain to be source-frozen.
canonical_claim: Every source-approved graph is planar exactly when it contains no source-defined subdivision or topological-minor model of K5 or K3,3, after all representation equivalences are checked.
statement_blocker: The catalog says only 'forbidden subgraphs'. It does not distinguish literal subgraphs, subdivisions, topological minors, or ordinary minors; fix finite versus general and simple versus multigraph scope; define planarity, plane embeddings, subdivisions, path-model containment, K5 and K3,3 representations; settle the Wagner ordinary-minor boundary; or state ordered binders, assumptions, conclusion, foundations, and degenerate cases. Selecting one Lean proposition at intake would resolve material source and ownership choices without review.
target_decision: preserve the conventional Kuratowski topological-minor/subdivision family, exclude literal-subgraph weakening and silent Wagner-minor substitution, and require independent source and representation review before the statement phase

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall (V : Type u) (G : SimpleGraph V), Planar G <-> (not (IsTopologicalMinor (completeGraph (Fin 5)) G) and not (IsTopologicalMinor (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) G))

domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix a finite or general graph carrier, simple or multi-edge structure, all vertex and path universes, planarity/plane-embedding data, subdivision and topological-minor witness types, obstruction vertex types, graph isomorphisms, and every finiteness, topology, decidability, and classical instance.
conclusion: Open formal target: a source-faithful equivalence between planarity and simultaneous absence of K5 and K3,3 subdivisions/topological-minor models, with the ordinary-minor form admitted only under an explicit checked neighbor-ownership decision.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake; the statement phase must resolve empty, singleton, edgeless, disconnected, low-cardinality, looped, parallel-edge, already-subdivided, and embedding-degenerate cases listed in scope-map.md.
